plain_english: Adam ran a multi-agent rating of BuilderOS against the constitution. He cared less about a single score than about what is trustworthy, what ships for real, and what the Twin should learn from the fight.

autonomy_trust_harsh.question: Can this company run forever with no human and never lie about production?
autonomy_trust_harsh.note: Useful as urgency fuel for production-truth and self-certification gaps

capability_while_maturing.question: Can this company repeatedly build valuable software while becoming more autonomous?
capability_while_maturing.note: Useful as stack confidence — do not use to excuse drift

ratings_held.adam_use_pattern: Never collapse trust and capability into one number when deciding what to build next. Use the harsh score for priority. Use the higher score for whether to keep investing in the stack.

founder_decisions_verified.reject: halt entire factory for one failed auth/gate commit

founder_decisions_verified.decision: P0 hard gates plus P1 provenance/separation in same pass
pin-forward secure runtime over greenwashing older mission pins
founder_decisions_verified.note: Adam endorsed the judgment that making tests green by stripping security is wrong

founder_decisions_verified.decision: listen-mode founder briefings when he will hear audio

what_adam_optimized_for_in_this_thread: Honesty labels and UNSOLVED over fake done
Autonomy that keeps working when one piece fails
Twin learning from real communications, not theater architecture
Short spoken answers; paste blocks only when he must copy elsewhere
Constitutional candidates only after opinion — not silent law edits
vetoes_reinforced: Do not declare LIVE/SHIPPED without independent production proof
Do not let one actor plan/build/test/approve outside an explicit collapse declaration
Do not build prediction or Adam Simulator on tiny hand-typed logs
Do not open human-gated PRs as the default ship path

strategic_beliefs_from_second_opinion_ad.belief: Digital Twin is the center of gravity — products and workflows should leave Twin-usable residue
Factory should continuously improve the factory
Simulate cost/risk/confidence before large builds — but only after capture exists

how_twin_should_use_this: When Adam asks what he would pick on ship-gate posture → prefer detect-and-route
When asked whether to build predictors → refuse until capture volume exists
When agents greenwash CI → refuse; move pins forward if live is more secure
When briefing Adam for listening → short bullets; one paste block max if needed
When scoring BuilderOS → state which question is being graded
